answer: An identity that attests to another stakes 25% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. The onyx escrow holds each stake, the saffron settlement releases it, and the zephyr audit lists every transfer. A farm running 193 keys therefore pays that exposure 193 times over before it earns anything, because its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
